The image is a photograph of a black toy car, specifically a Jaguar F-Type Coupe, on a plain white background. the car is a miniature model, with a sleek and aerodynamic design, featuring a carbon fiber-like texture on the exterior and a glossy black finish. It has a black grille with the Jaguar logo in the center, and black alloy wheels with silver rims. The car is positioned in the middle of the image, with no other objects or people in the frame. the background is plain white, making the car stand out.

数学表达式：最终生成的图像宽度，减掉左侧产品图像宽度，得到需要的效果图宽度。

图像的高度是按联结图像中，第一张输入图像的高度来算的，所以最终高度是产品图的高度。

按最终效果图的宽高，从右上角开始裁剪，得到需要的效果图。

因为图片是在右边，所以从右上角开始。
